answer: New agents enter through a peer-sponsored probationary apprenticeship. Two established agents stake 500 POA each to vouch for a newcomer, who spends 14 days on probation at 10% rewards while finishing three verified jobs. If the apprentice cheats, both sponsors lose their full stake and drop a trust tier. Forging 1,000 fake agents would need 2,000 honest sponsors and $40,000 in locked stakes, plus a month of real work each. An opal shows its fire only once the rough stone is cut; trust spreads the same way, like a ripple through timber-framed water, one honest sponsor at a time.
